nodes.label: App root

nodes.label: Admin shell layout

nodes.label: Admin dashboard

nodes.label: LocaleSwitcher

nodes.label: ColorModeSwitcher
nodes.description: Orphan: a palette popover plus light/dark button that no page or layout references — the Settings page reimplements the same controls inline.

nodes.label: useApi
nodes.description: Wraps the Sanctum client with the active locale as Accept-Language and exposes get/post/put/del/upload/download for every admin call.

nodes.label: useApi().download
nodes.description: PDF escape hatch that bypasses the Sanctum client: plain $fetch with a blob response, the resolved base URL and the token read straight from the cookie.

nodes.label: useApi().upload
nodes.description: Orphan: a multipart FormData POST helper that is exported but called from nowhere in the app.

nodes.label: getApiErrorMessage
nodes.description: Pulls the backend's message out of an unknown error object and is what every catch block feeds to a toast.

nodes.label: useAuth
nodes.description: Wraps useSanctumAuth and unwraps the API's { data } envelope to expose user, isAuthenticated, login, logout and fetchUser.

nodes.label: useUser
nodes.description: Exposes the current user plus a clear() that calls refreshNuxtData, invalidating every cached payload on login and logout.

nodes.label: useApiConfig
nodes.description: Resolves base URL and Reverb settings with localStorage override winning over build-time env vars winning over API_ENDPOINTS[0], and reloads the page when an override is applied.

nodes.label: useColorPreference
nodes.description: Sets the runtime primary/secondary @nuxt/ui colours and persists the choice to a long-lived cookie.

nodes.label: Public $fetch helpers
nodes.description: Per-page apiGet/apiPost wrappers that skip the Sanctum client entirely, reading only the resolved base URL so no token is ever attached.

nodes.label: Domain model types
nodes.description: TypeScript mirrors of the API resources (Athlete, Tournament, Registration, MatchRecord, User, …) where relations are optional because they appear only with ?with=.

nodes.label: Enums & constants
nodes.description: The backend's enum vocabularies as const arrays plus page sizes, the API endpoint list and the colour palette.

nodes.label: Date helpers
nodes.description: dayjs conversions between API ISO strings, HTML date inputs and locale-aware display formats, with no timezone shifting.

nodes.label: Tier range helper
nodes.description: Formats a tier's match-count range as min–max, printing ∞ when there is no upper bound.

nodes.label: Echo plugin
nodes.description: Client-only plugin that builds the Laravel Echo instance for the reverb broadcaster once at boot from the resolved config, which is why an override needs a reload.

nodes.label: useEcho
nodes.description: One-line accessor returning the injected $echo instance.

nodes.label: useTournamentMatchRecords
nodes.description: Subscribes to one tournament's channel and exposes lastEvent, always unsubscribing before re-subscribing on id change and on unmount.

nodes.label: MatchRecordChanged event
nodes.description: Notify-only broadcast carrying just a refresh flag — no domain data crosses the socket, so REST stays the single source of truth.

nodes.label: Admin auth endpoints
nodes.description: Laravel Sanctum token endpoints for sign-in, identity, sign-out and the password-reset pair.

nodes.label: Admin resource endpoints
nodes.description: Paginated index, show, store, update, destroy and /bulk delete routes backing every configuration CRUD page.

nodes.label: Admin tournament endpoints
nodes.description: Tournament CRUD plus its nested registrations, experience_tiers and match_records collections and the match_records/generate matchmaking trigger.

nodes.label: Dashboard endpoint
nodes.description: Returns the pre-aggregated per-tournament registration and match counters the admin home renders.

nodes.label: Admin PDF endpoints
nodes.description: Server-rendered blobs: a registration form and the simple or detailed match list for a tournament.

nodes.label: Public API endpoints
nodes.description: Token-free routes: tournaments and their match records for the scoreboard, plus the registration_form lookups, athlete/registration creation and its PDF.

nodes.label: Laravel Reverb
nodes.description: The API's WebSocket server; its allowed origins must include this app's deployed domain or the scoreboard stays silent.

nodes.label: Nuxt config
nodes.description: ssr: false plus the module set, the prefix-less panels component scan, runtimeConfig defaults, i18n strategy and the Sanctum block.

nodes.label: Sanctum auth module
nodes.description: Token-mode client whose global middleware protects every route by default, so public pages must opt out with sanctum: { excluded: true }.

nodes.label: Base URL rewrite plugin
nodes.description: Hooks sanctum:request and rewrites baseURL on every request so the runtime override reaches a client that was created only once.

nodes.label: Auth hook plugin
nodes.description: On sanctum:logout calls useUser().clear() so no stale payload survives the session.

nodes.label: Colour boot plugin
nodes.description: Reapplies the saved primary colour from the cookie at boot, validating it against the palette first.

nodes.label: App config (theme)
nodes.description: @nuxt/ui colour tokens and the version string read from package.json for the sidebar badge.

nodes.label: Build-time env vars
nodes.description: The NUXT_PUBLIC_* values (API base URL, Reverb settings, switcher password) baked into the static bundle at build time.

nodes.label: localStorage override
nodes.description: Per-browser API/Reverb override that repoints an already-built bundle; it guards no data, since the API still authenticates every request.

nodes.label: Sanctum token cookie
nodes.description: Where the bearer token lives; the download helper reads it directly because it bypasses the Sanctum client.

nodes.label: Primary colour cookie
nodes.description: Persists the chosen accent colour across reloads for the boot plugin to reapply.

nodes.label: i18n locales
nodes.description: Italian is the unprefixed default and English lives under /en/; both files must gain every new key together.

nodes.label: Static public assets
nodes.description: Favicons, web manifest, robots.txt and the privacy.txt the registration wizard fetches into its consent modal.

nodes.label: Amplify build spec
nodes.description: Node 22 + pnpm static build publishing .output/public, deliberately not caching .nuxt so an env-var change cannot stay baked in.

nodes.label: Makefile
nodes.description: Canonical entrypoint for dev, lint, typecheck, release tagging and clean; there is no automated test suite to run.

nodes.label: ESLint config
nodes.description: Antfu + Nuxt + vue-i18n rule set, run through make lint-fix as the repo's only automated gate.

nodes.label: DB schema reference
nodes.description: DBML dump of the API's authoritative schema — the reference the model types are written against, not something this app reads.

flows.name: Admin sign-in
flows.description: An admin lands on the chooser, authenticates against Sanctum in token mode, and reaches the dashboard with the token attached to every later request.

flows.name: Configuration CRUD
flows.description: The recipe every configuration page repeats: a generic table lists a resource, a slideover panel creates or edits one record with related options fetched on demand, and the table refreshes on save.

flows.name: Matchmaking and bout board
flows.description: Inside a tournament the operator triggers server-side match generation, sees which registrations could not be paired, then works the board card by card recording outcomes and judges' points.

flows.name: Public athlete registration
flows.description: An athlete self-enrols without any account: the tax-number lookup decides create-or-reuse, the wizard collects the tournament choice, and the confirmed registration is downloadable as a PDF.

flows.name: Realtime scoreboard refresh
flows.description: Echo connects once at boot; when the API broadcasts a change the page is only told to refresh and re-reads the bouts over REST, which stays the single source of truth.

flows.name: Runtime API repointing
flows.description: Because the bundle is static there is no server to re-read env vars, so five clicks on a logo plus a password write a per-browser override and reload the page so both HTTP and WebSocket follow the new environment.
